content.text: We keep paying for Ontraport and barely use the automations. Should we move the CRM somewhere cheaper?

content.thinking: Let me weigh GoHighLevel vs HubSpot for this use case before answering.

content.text: Both GoHighLevel and HubSpot can replace Ontraport. The reason GoHighLevel fits better here is the bundled SMS and white-label agency tier, which matches the BuilderBee delivery model.
Okay, let's go with GoHighLevel then. Lock it in.
Confirmed. We decided to migrate from Ontraport to GoHighLevel for the BuilderBee CRM. I'll export the Ontraport contacts and stand up the GoHighLevel pipelines next.
One more thing — note that the membership renewals run on the 1st, so the cutover has to finish before month-end.
Understood. Important: the cutover must complete before the 1st because renewal automations fire then. I'll schedule the migration for the last weekend of the month.
Let me bring you the rollout decisions once the export finishes — nothing to decide yet on the data-mapping side.
